summary: krffs_hosttest.c's rows on the fields of a node no path reaches yet, with faults in a private copy of rach2/sys/fs/krffs.c, each the code as it stood before its fix

argv:
set -eu
t=${WORK}/tree
sh tests/proofs/tree.sh "$t" ${SRC} rach2/sys tests/host
cd "$t"
exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -I rach2/sys -I rach2/sys/lib -I rach2/sys/proc -o ${WORK}/krffs_hosttest tests/host/krffs_hosttest.c rach2/sys/lib/kstring.c rach2/sys/lib/kctypes.c

faults.name: new-id-rule
faults.summary: a create that writes the new node's id under the whole-unit rule

lines: krffs_hosttest: FAIL: a node whose id falls across a block is made with the whole-unit rule on

faults.name: id-taken
faults.summary: a mkdir that makes a directory whose id another directory has

lines: krffs_hosttest: FAIL: a second directory with the first one's identifier is refused

faults.name: taken-is-bad
faults.summary: a taken directory id refused as KRFFS_EBAD, a full or failing volume

lines: krffs_hosttest: FAIL: with the result of a taken identifier, which names no full or failing volume

faults.name: mkdir-id-rule
faults.summary: a mkdir that writes the new directory's id under the whole-unit rule

edits.find: rc |= krffs_put_new_u64(mount, node, KRFFS_FIELD_ID, krffs_mix_id(parent_id, base));
edits.replace: rc |= krffs_put_u64(mount, node, KRFFS_FIELD_ID, krffs_mix_id(parent_id, base));

lines: krffs_hosttest: FAIL: a directory whose id falls across a block is made with the whole-unit rule on

faults.name: copy-times-rule
faults.summary: a move's copy that writes its access time under the whole-unit rule

lines: krffs_hosttest: FAIL: a file that has to move where its field falls across a block moves with the whole-unit rule on

faults.name: copy-length-rule
faults.summary: a move's copy that writes its length under the whole-unit rule

lines: krffs_hosttest: FAIL: a node made over a removed node's length across a block is made with the whole-unit rule on

faults.name: new-times-rule
faults.summary: a new node's modification time written under the whole-unit rule

lines: krffs_hosttest: FAIL: a node whose field falls across a block is made with the whole-unit rule on

faults.name: parent-is-file
faults.summary: a parent lookup that takes an earlier non-directory with the directory's id

lines: krffs_hosttest: FAIL: dot-dot skips a non-directory with the parent's id
